name: Belt & Pulley Calculator
blurb: belt length and ratio from pulley diameters and centre distance
intro: The pitch length of an open belt around two pulleys and the speed ratio, or the centre distance for a belt you already have. Exact open-belt geometry; for timing belts it works in teeth and lists the closed belts nearest your layout.

examples.title: V-belt 80 mm to 200 mm on a 1250 mm belt

usage: Choose the belt (flat/V by diameters in mm, or a timing profile with pulley tooth counts), then either give the centre distance in mm to get the belt length, or the belt length in mm (teeth for timing belts) to get the centre distance. It returns belt pitch length, centre distance, speed ratio, wrap angle and, for timing belts, belt teeth, teeth in mesh and the nearest closed belts with their centre distances. Use it when laying out a belt drive or picking a belt.
sources: Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, section 17-2: open-belt length and contact angle
Gates PowerGrip GT / HTD and Optibelt timing belt catalogues: pitches and pitch-line differentials
Teeth-in-mesh (6) and wrap (120°) minimums: belt makers' rule of thumb
